conditional_gap_note: At a given sampled field, any partition of P(x) into groups of weights 1/5 and 4/5 satisfies |mean_x1-mean_x2| <= 2.5 sd(x), by the law of total variance. This is a bound for that finite-cell distribution, not an uncertainty on a bulk phase boundary.
restricted_K0_note: Each unbiased run stayed in one assigned basin. K=0 partition functions are separate for Q <= cutoff and Q > cutoff; the number of starts sets no phase weights.
